title: Create session request
description: Body of POST /api/sessions. The creator becomes facilitator (FR-001, FR-002). When `method` is absent the server uses its default method (the one GET /api/methods lists first and the creation form preselects); an unknown key gets 400. `scale` defaults to CONTINUOUS up to 10 (allowedValues is ignored in a request).

method.description: Key of a method from GET /api/methods; its latest version is used, then frozen (FR-017, FR-017d).
